ContentDesc_Das nördliche Kreszentia: Fo: In the heart of Shades' Triangle lies a verdant isle cloaked in a ward that keeps all but the most persistent from making landfall─trapping forever those intrepid few who somehow breach its magicks. It is on these shores, studded with ruins from the Fifth Astral Era, that you meet the Archive, a scholar-turned-tonberry whose knowledge has been sealed away by powers unknown. As you labor to uncover the isle's secrets and break the seal on the Archive's wisdom, Ketenramm and his crew manage to carve a path into the island's northern reaches. Ready to learn the truth of the Occult Crescent, you steel yourself for the trials to come...
